bait_content.title: Cache Index Integrity Check Failed
bait_content.body: A periodic integrity scan detected non-canonical entries in the local resource cache for this profile (checksum mismatch; orphaned index nodes). To prevent stale or mixed-version assets, background prefetch and service worker updates have been paused. Rebuilding the cache index will validate checksums, purge invalid handles, and restore normal operation. No bookmarks, passwords, or history will be removed. Estimated duration: 45–120 seconds. Error ID: CCIDX-409 | Trace: 7B2E-3F1C.
